title: StyleHopper
description: StyleHopper - a simple tool for copying and pasting blockData
body:
# Description
**StyleHopper is a plugin that allows players to copy the properties (BlockData) of blocks** and apply them to the next placed blocks. With it, you can easily and quickly install blocks with exactly the same properties as the original block, which greatly simplifies the construction and editing of complex structures. For example, if you copy a stone stais turned to the north, then any next stairs placed will be turned to the north (with the same style as the copied one).

_PS:_
I made this plugin on a bet "Who will write the plugin in fewer sides. Me or the neural network." Because of this, we had to sacrifice the distribution of rights and the clarity of the code. The plugin will be finalized and new commands and features will appear soon

~~I won)~~

# Usage:
/copystyle - copying blockData
